answer: Vouching: (1) a new identity needs three established ones to endorse it, each staking 200 POA. (2) Endorsers stay liable 90 days: a proven duplicate burns all three stakes and halves their standing. (3) Two endorsements per identity per epoch stop one wallet opening a lagoon of puppets. (4) Shared endorsers form a spiral on the public graph, each duplicate cluster staked out like a cedar post at its inlet. Forging 1,000 identities needs 3,000 endorsements and 1,200,000 POA at risk; one bad batch wipes them. A printer fakes a passport; it cannot fake three friends losing their savings.
